texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的地表正在对我们的建设活动表现出前所未有的反应。一种无法甄别的粘稠物质开始从关键设施的地基中渗出。

这种渗出物是一种深红色液体，外观呈胶状，摸起来极具粘性。

我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]迫切希望进一步研究这种排放物。虽然目前它仅仅带来些许不便，但为确保[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的安全，最好还是谨慎行事。
texts.en:
The surface of [Root.GetName] is exhibiting an unprecedented reaction to our construction efforts. An unidentified viscous substance is beginning to ooze out from the foundations of key installations.

The ooze is some kind of crimson liquid; gelatinous in appearance but extremely adhesive to the touch.

Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are eager to study this discharge further. Currently it is a mere inconvenience, but it would be prudent to ensure the safety of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]报告了关于神秘猩红色粘液的新进展，结果令人不安。

这种物质正变得难以控制，在受影响的区域以更快的速度涌现。

这种粘液并非毫无益处。随着其凝固，其粘合特性变得更加显著，有效地形成了一种天然水泥，对于我们建设工作的进展可以作为有效补充。

然而，令人担忧的是，这种物质几乎无法从任何接触它的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]身上清除。尝试治疗和研究受影响的工人将使我们能够收集更多信息，但会减缓建设进度。
texts.en:
[Root.GetName] reports troubling developments regarding the strange crimson ooze.

The substance is becoming unmanageable, emerging at a greater rate throughout the afflicted areas.

The ooze is not without its benefits. As it coagulates, its adhesive properties become more pronounced, effectively forming a natural cement that can be used to supplement our construction efforts.

Worryingly though, the substance proves nearly impossible to remove from any [Owner.GetColonistPlural] who come into contact with it. Attempting to treat and study those affected would allow us to gather more information but would slow construction progress.

label.zh: 治疗并研究沾染粘液的人。

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的建设以异常顺利的速度持续推进，但那种粘稠物质的出现已不再仅限于我们设施的地基部分。

多处地点发现了渗漏的裂缝。最初，只有[Root.GetName]上的非本土物体受到这种物质的影响，但现在它正在无差别地扩散。

该物质现已吞噬了[Root.GetName]表面的大部分区域，并迅速凝结成厚厚的矿物凝结物，将[Root.GetName]包围。

通过代价高昂的反复试验，我们的工程师找到了一种方法来减轻进一步的损害，并高效地采集这种物质。然而，这只能通过向这种粘液让出大量土地来实现。
texts.en:
Construction on [Root.GetName] has continued at an exceptional pace, but the emergence of the viscous substance is no longer limited to just the foundations of our installations.

Hemorrhaging fissures have been discovered in multiple locations. Initially only non-native objects to [Root.GetName] were being affected by the substance, but now it is spreading indiscriminately.

The material has now consumed a large portion of the surface of [Root.GetName] and is rapidly congealing into a thick mineral coagulate that has surrounded [Root.GetName].

Through costly trial and error, our engineers have found a way to mitigate further damage as well as efficiently harvest the substance. This was only possible at the expense of ceding significant ground to the ooze.

texts.zh:
在对[Root.GetName]上受影响的工人进行深入研究和治疗后，我们的科学家已成功隔离出问题的根源。

尽管表面上看上去是一种粘稠凝胶状物质，实际上这是一群与星球形成共生关系的寄生微生物。这些寄生虫在[Root.GetName]的地壳下分解有机物，并将其回收转化为新的物质。

[Root.GetName]的开发活动扰乱了它们的自然生命周期，导致它们对我们引入其生态系统的外来物质产生了反应。

我们的科研团队相信，假以时日，我们能够找到与这些生命体和谐共处的方法，并将其独特的生物学特性整合到[Root.GetName]的生产流程中。
texts.en:
After intense study and treatment of the afflicted workers on [Root.GetName], our scientists have isolated the root cause of the problem.

What initially presented as a viscous gelatinous substance, is in fact a collection of parasitic microorganisms that form a symbiotic relationship with the planet. The parasites decompose organic matter beneath the crust of [Root.GetName] and recycle it into new material.

The disturbance caused by [Root.GetName]'s development disrupted their natural lifecycle, causing them to react to the foreign substances we introduced into their ecosystem.

Given more time, our science team is confident that we can find a way to work in harmony with these lifeforms, integrating their unique biology into [Root.GetName]'s production pipelines.

texts.zh:
通过广泛的研究，我们的科学家成功对[Root.GetName]上的寄生微生物进行了基因定向设计。这种变异旨在使它们将我们的材料识别为对自然生态无害的添加物，从而使我们能够继续建设而不再遇到问题。

在将这些基因改造后的寄生虫引入行星生物圈后，它们已成功融入其中。

此外，通过重新利用微生物原有的分解效应，我们成功利用该物质的粘合特性，提升了行星的生产效率。
texts.en:
Through extensive research, our scientists have engineered a variant species of the parasitic microorganisms on [Root.GetName]. This mutation is designed to recognize our own materials as harmless additions to their natural ecology, enabling us to resume construction with no further issue.

After introducing them into the planet's biosphere, our engineered parasites have successfully integrated with it.

Furthermore, by repurposing the microorganisms' original decomposition effects, we have managed to harness the substance's adhesive properties to boost our planet's production processes.

label.en: And what can they teach us?
